theme: Reflection Lines, Rotational Symmetry & Art Patterns

conceptual_foundation.introduction: Explores visual balance, mirror reflections, quarter/half turns of shapes, paper firkis (windmills), Rajasthani block printing, and alphabet symmetry.

core_concepts.explanation: A figure has line symmetry if it can be folded along a straight line (axis of symmetry) such that the two halves overlap perfectly.
core_concepts.example: The letter 'H' has 2 lines of symmetry (1 vertical, 1 horizontal); letter 'A' has 1 vertical line of symmetry.

core_concepts.explanation: A shape has rotational symmetry if it looks identical to its original position after a partial turn (1/4 turn, 1/3 turn, 1/2 turn) around its central point.
core_concepts.example: A 4-blade paper firki / windmill looks identical after every 1/4 turn (90° rotation).

core_concepts.concept: Quarter (1/4) Turn vs Half (1/2) Turn Transformations
core_concepts.explanation: Analyzing how shapes, numbers, and letters transform under 1/4 turns (90°) and 1/2 turns (180°).
core_concepts.example: The number '8' looks the same after a 1/2 turn; the letter 'S' looks identical after a 1/2 turn but upside down/different after 1/4 turn.

core_concepts.explanation: In a plane mirror, left and right sides interchange (lateral inversion). Asymmetrical figures have no line of symmetry and do not match their mirror image.
core_concepts.example: The letter 'P' or 'F' is asymmetrical and appears reversed in a mirror.

core_concepts.explanation: Creating repeating symmetrical borders and motifs using vegetable cutouts, ink-blot folds, and wood blocks.
core_concepts.example: Folding paper, dropping ink, pressing flat, and opening to reveal a bilateral symmetrical butterfly design.

key_formulas_and_rules: Line of Symmetry divides a figure into 2 congruent mirror halves
Order of Rotational Symmetry = Number of times a figure matches itself during 1 full 360° turn
Square has 4 lines of symmetry and rotational symmetry of order 4
Circle has infinitely many lines of symmetry
real_world_applications: Graphic logo design, textile & carpet block printing, architectural facade symmetry, tile manufacturing, and brand trademark aesthetics.
